text:
Maya Patel: Quick design question — in the spend dashboard mock, do we want the little minimap (left rail) that shows time range + sparkline, or keep the toolbar top controls? Thinking about scannability vs persistent context.
Kevin Tran: I prefer toolbar. Minimap looks neat but hides what scope you're on unless you expand it. top controls are more discoverable. :thinking_face:
Elena Rios: Agree with Kevin for discoverability. Also accessibility concern: the minimap's contrast is low and it's not obvious to screen reader users. If we keep it we need an `aria-label` and keyboard focus.
Sam O'Neill: Counterpoint — minimap helps with quick brushing to select ranges without using dropdowns. For power users it reduces clicks. Could be collapsed by default for new users.
Jordan Wu: What about a hybrid? show toolbar for scope (Org / Project / Time) and a compact minimap under the chart header that is purely visual (no interaction) to avoid keyboard traps. Expanded state keeps interactive scrubber.
Maya Patel: Hybrid seems promising. Main asks: 1) primary affordance for scope selection (org vs project) — is that toolbar chip or left rail? 2) token breakdown and invoice download CTA — where to place so it isn't lost when scrolling charts.
Kevin Tran: My vote: toolbar chip for scope; token breakdown pinned to right column as a compact card with totals + CTA. Invoice download should be a persistent action in the header (top-right) so it's always visible.
Elena Rios: Accessibility nit: ensure the pinned token card has meaningful headings and that the invoice button uses `aria-haspopup="dialog"` if it opens a modal. Also check color contrast on the token delta badges — current mock fails AA at small sizes.
Sam O'Neill: UX nit on copy: current label "Tokens used" is ambiguous for multi-model orgs. Suggest "Total tokens (all models)" and break out by model in expandable rows.
Jordan Wu: Layout proposal: toolbar (scope + time) at top, chart area with compact minimap beneath header, right column: token breakdown + invoice CTA + quick links (API keys, billing settings). Mobile: collapse right column into accordion below chart.
Maya Patel: Love the proposal. Next steps: Elena to audit color/contrast and keyboard flows; Sam to draft copy updates; Jordan to supply updated responsive mocks; Kevin to run quick usability with 3 folks tomorrow.
designbot: Reminder: design review scheduled Thu 2pm. Upload updated Figma frames to the shared project by Wed EOD. (posted by designbot)
Elena Rios: I'll run the contrast check and add `aria-label`s. Flagging one more item: keyboard focus order breaks when minimap is interactive — need to ensure logical tab sequence.
Kevin Tran: I'll recruit 3 people for 15-min hallway testing tomorrow at 10:30am, focusing on scope switching and invoice flow.
Maya Patel: Thanks all. If we settle on hybrid I'll update the PR with the header CTA pattern and pin behavior. :thumbsup:
